items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: The only guys I know were Steve Gadd and I think Cranshaw might have been on one of the dates.

ctx.x: I love that. I love the outtro at the end of “Kodachrome” man, that thing is rockin’. There’s that piano part [scats]. Who was that?
I don’t know. I don’t know. The only guys I know were Steve Gadd and I think Cranshaw might have been on one of the dates. Richard Davis, do you know that name Richard Davis the bass player?
